seed_bootstrap: resample 3 paired seed indices with replacement using shared class-stratified image samples; exploratory with only 3 seeds
ece_intervals: percentile, paired raw-minus-TS, conditional on fixed fitted models and temperatures; adaptive boundaries recomputed in each replicate
aurc: mean cumulative error at retained counts 1..N; confidence descending, image_id ascending tie break; E-AURC subtracts finite-sample optimal ordering at same error count
metadata_baseline: cultivar-majority rule fitted only to training rows, lexicographic ties and training-majority fallback; full-pool score separately labeled resubstitution
ensemble: mean raw class probabilities of 3 seeds within same architecture; one scalar T fitted on source-validation ensemble probabilities using bounded log-temperature minimization [.05,20], xatol 1e-8 maxiter 500; no target labels for fitting
strict_rules: source-only empirical risk limits .01,.02,.05, minimum 20 accepted validation images and 20% coverage; no eligible threshold means reject all
